sn10.10:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rajagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrel Sanctuary.
sn10.10:1.2: Now on that occasion a certain lay follower gave food to the bhikkhuni Sukka.
sn10.10:1.3: Then a yakkha who had full confidence in the bhikkhuni Sukka, going from street to street and from square to square in Rajagaha, on that occasion recited this verse:
sn10.10:2.2: Wise indeed is this lay follower,
sn10.10:2.3: Who just gave food to Sukka,
sn10.10:2.4: One released from all the knots.
